Meet the brilliant actor Sanjay Mishra in this amazing episode of The Slow Interview with Neelesh Misra.
Har Kisse Ke Hisse - Kaamyaab is an upcoming movie by Red Chillies Entertainment and Drishyam Films. Starring Sanjay Mishra and Deepak Dobriyal in the lead roles. This movie presents the story of a fictional character Sudheer, struggling to land the 500th role of his career as an extra in the Bollywood industry.
